summary.text: Son of Dionysus and Ariadne — or of other fathers in rival genealogies — eponym of Phlius near Sicyon, numbered among the Argonauts.

story.text: Apollonius names Phlias among the crew from the Peloponnese; Hyginus makes him son of Liber and Ariadne from Phlius, though others call him Theban.
